basic_info.description: This striking, fully detached Art Deco home on a coveted corner lot in Miraloma Park makes an unforgettable first impression with manicured gardens, bold curb appeal, and a design-forward renovation that brings timeless architecture into the now. Inside, enjoy smart home features, generous light-filled living spaces, and effortless indoor-outdoor flow. The main level features 3 bedrooms plus an ideal home office, 2 remodeled bathrooms, and a luxe primary suite with a walk-in closet, and a spa-like bathroom with rain shower, radiant heat, and your very own dry sauna. A formal dining room with a Parisian balcony, expansive living room with sleek gas fireplace, and chef's dream kitchen with custom cabinetry, Sub-Zero fridge, Wolf range, and marble backsplash complete the main floor. The lower level offers a spacious guest suite, versatile media room, and laundry. Additional highlights include Lutron blinds, immersive Sonos audio, CAT-5 wiring, recessed LED lighting, custom closets, and a 2 car side-by-side garage. Enjoy easy access to Miraloma Playground & Elementary, Forest Hill MUNI, West Portal Village, shopping and dining on Portola Drive, and stunning trails at Mt. Davidson, Glen Canyon, and Twin Peaks. This is a statement home for a life well-lived.
